https://metro.co.uk/2021/11/26/when-does.title: When does Black Friday start and end in 2021?
https://metro.co.uk/2021/11/26/when-does.text:
Black Friday is an annual shopping event that sees some of the world’s biggest brands offer decent discounts on their best-selling and most popular products.
This year, we’ve already seen the prices slashed on everything from Nintendo Switches to sex toys – and a jaw-dropping 100% off at Pretty Little Thing.
But when does this shopping bonanza end?
Here’s all you need to know.
Black Friday 2021 is today – November 26.
The sale will technically end at midnight – but that doesn’t mean you can’t still nab a deal afterward.
Much like in previous years, stores, websites, and brands extend their sales over the whole weekend, and even into the following Monday.
This day is known as ‘Cyber Monday’ – which falls on Monday, November 19 this year.
So, the real last time to grab a bargain will be on Monday at 11.59pm.
Black Friday was always more strongly associated with shops on the high street or in shopping malls and the decent discounts they would offer on their products for one day.
Cyber Monday is the internet-based equivalent of Black Friday forged by online retailers after the explosion and popularisation of online shopping – it debuted in 2005, and has become a sales staple since.
However, Black Friday and Cyber Monday are no longer separate entities as the lines between the world of physical shopping and online become more and more blurred.
